reason: A remote workspace plugin for connecting to SSH servers, browsing and editing remote files, and running server commands through a web interface; human review is warranted because it supports broad remote command execution and file writes.

summaries.zh: 通过SSH连接一台或多台服务器，在DSH界面中浏览文件、编辑并保存代码以及执行远程命令。
summaries.en: Connect to one or more SSH servers from DSH to browse files, edit and save code, and run remote commands.

capabilities: Connects to one or more SSH servers
Edits and saves remote text files
Executes arbitrary commands on remote servers
Stores connection settings in browser localStorage
